fr.english: District agrometeorological bulletin index with a state and union territory selector
fr.translation: Index des bulletins agrométéorologiques de district avec sélecteur d’États et de territoires de l’Union

fr.english: The official English-language index displays a selector and document viewer for district bulletins.
fr.translation: L’index officiel en langue anglaise affiche un sélecteur et une visionneuse de documents pour les bulletins de district.

fr.english: Public index read without an account. Individual bulletins and automated access were not tested.
fr.translation: Index public consulté sans compte. Les bulletins individuels et l’accès automatisé n’ont pas été testés.

fr.english: District coverage, bulletin publication and forecast validity remain unverified. The index does not establish local crop recommendations.
fr.translation: La couverture des districts, la publication des bulletins et la validité des prévisions demeurent non vérifiées. L’index n’établit pas de recommandations de cultures locales.

sw.english: District agrometeorological bulletin index with a state and union territory selector
sw.translation: Fahirisi ya majarida ya agrometeorolojia ya wilaya yenye kiteuzi cha majimbo na maeneo ya muungano

sw.english: The official English-language index displays a selector and document viewer for district bulletins.
sw.translation: Fahirisi rasmi ya lugha ya Kiingereza inaonyesha kiteuzi na kionyeshi cha nyaraka kwa majarida ya wilaya.

sw.english: Public index read without an account. Individual bulletins and automated access were not tested.
sw.translation: Fahirisi ya umma iliyosomwa bila akaunti. Taarifa za kila wilaya na ufikiaji wa kiotomatiki havikujaribiwa.

sw.english: District coverage, bulletin publication and forecast validity remain unverified. The index does not establish local crop recommendations.
sw.translation: Eneo la wilaya linalofunikwa, uchapishaji wa taarifa na uhalali wa utabiri vinabaki bila kuthibitishwa. Fahirisi haithibitishi mapendekezo ya mazao ya eneo husika.
